C45040.observed: What was checked: that the Category box is a proper pick-list of the shop's own categories, and that a part saved without picking one still ends up as "Uncategorized". What happened: opening the Category box listed the shop's categories - Uncategorized, 70%override, AUTO-Batteries, AUTO-Brakes, AUTO-Engine and many more. A part was then saved from the quick row without touching Category at all; the work order's Parts tab shows that part with Category "Uncategorized", as required. Worth knowing: the detailed part window shows its Category box empty for such a part, but the value actually stored and shown in the Parts list is Uncategorized.

C45046.observed: What was checked: that saving from the detailed part window adds the part and closes both that window and the quick row, without opening a fresh row. What happened: a part was started in the quick row, "More options" was pressed, the window's required Category was set, and "Save part" pressed. The part was added, the window closed, the quick row closed too, and no new row opened. Worth knowing: pressing "Save part" without a Category is refused with "Category is a required field" - the window applies its own checks, which is correct and is what test C45057 covers.

C45063.observed: What was checked: that pressing Edit on a part opens the detailed part window already filled in with that part's current values. What happened: pressing Edit opened the window headed "Edit Part Request" carrying the part's own values - description "ZZAUTOTEST requested flow", quantity 1, cost 2.00, sell price 4.00. Nothing had to be re-typed.

C45064.observed: What was checked: that a Full View user is never given the small inline edit row - editing always goes to the detailed window instead. What happened: pressing Edit opened the detailed window and the part line was not replaced by an editable row anywhere on the page.

C45065.observed: What was checked: that saving from the detailed window updates the part on the line, closes the window, and does not open a quick row afterwards. What happened: the part's quantity was changed from 1 to 9 and "Save & close" pressed. The part line updated on the spot - quantity 9 and the amount changed from $4.00 to $36.00 - the window closed, and no quick row opened.

C45067.observed: What was checked: that backing out of the detailed window throws away any changes made in it and leaves the part exactly as it was. What happened: the quantity was changed to 55 inside the window and the window was then closed with its × button. The part line was compared before and after and is character-for-character identical - quantity still 1, amount still $4.00. Nothing was kept.

C45068.observed: What was checked: that if you are part-way through typing a new part and then press Edit on an existing one, you are warned before your typing is thrown away. What happened: with "ZZAUTOTEST edit-guard" typed into a new part row, pressing Edit on an existing part brought up "Discard this part?" - "The details you entered will be lost." with "Keep Editing" and "Discard Part". The detailed part window did NOT open while that warning was up, and the part being typed was still there. The warning comes first, exactly as required.
